verdict.rationale: Radar's rules engine lets ops map outcomes (block, review, allow, request 3DS) to custom conditions including risk attributes, and 'risk settings' explicitly frame this as balancing authorization vs fraud risk appetite rather than a fixed cutoff (docs-1, docs-3, docs-13, docs-14, docs-17, docs-18). However, there's no explicit documentation snippet showing a 'risk score range -> action' mapping UI, and community reports note that Allow Rules aren't enabled by default and that Block rules were not overridable via the UI, causing false positives requiring manual support intervention — a real caveat on self-service threshold tuning (comm-3, comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit score-range-to-action mapping documentation, and independent confirmation that ops can freely tune/override thresholds without support intervention.
